summary.description: One or two sentences on why the build failed and what the fix does.

failure_category.description: Primary cause of the build failure.

root_cause.description: The first real error from the build log and why it happened.

error_excerpt.description: The log lines that show the root cause, copied verbatim.

confidence.description: Confidence from 0 to 1 that the proposed changes fix the build.

changes.description: Minimal changes to execution-environment.yml, in the order to apply them.

action.description: What to do to the item.

item.description: Package, collection, image, or setting being changed, for example jmespath or community.general.

from_value.description: Current value or version constraint. Empty when adding.

to_value.description: New value or version constraint. Empty when removing.

reason.description: Why this change fixes the failure.

retry_recommended.description: True when the build should be retried with the updated definition.

requires_human_review.description: True when the fix touches credentials, registry authentication, network access, or the base image.
